description: This file defines a PHP class 'S3File' within the namespace 'Goteo\Library\FileHandler'. The class manages file operations on Amazon S3 storage, including connecting, uploading, downloading, deleting, renaming, and retrieving metadata. It extends 'BaseFile' and implements 'FileInterface'. The class encapsulates logic for handling remote files on S3, including connection management, file transfers, and auxiliary operations like generating public URLs.

classes.name: S3File
classes.description: A class handling file operations over Amazon S3, including connect, upload, download, delete, rename, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the S3File object with user credentials, bucket, and path. Sets exceptions for S3 operations.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to S3 bucket using provided credentials and configures region.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the current S3 connection by nullifying the link.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Checks if a specified path exists on S3 and returns it if found.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads a local file or a stream to S3 at the specified remote path, with optional permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a remote file on S3.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Recursively deletes the contents of a remote directory on S3.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Retrieves a remote file from S3 and saves it locally.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a remote file on S3 by copying and deleting the original.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a remote file.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of a remote file.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a remote file exists on S3.

methods.name: get_contents
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of a remote file as a string.

methods.name: put_contents
methods.description: Stores data into a remote file on S3, appending if necessary.

methods.name: get_save_name
methods.description: Generates a unique filename on S3 based on a desired remote name.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the path component for S3 file operations, removing leading slashes.

methods.name: s3_acl
methods.description: Returns the ACL string for S3 operations based on permission level.

methods.name: get_public_url
methods.description: Returns a publicly accessible URL for a given filename on S3.
